# The environments' var files hold no secret values (see README.md):
# commit them.
!vars/**/*.tfvars
-- README.md --
# aws/eu-west-2

Generated by infraharvest: one root whose code every environment shares (dev, prod). What differs between them is in `vars/<env>/`: `terraform.tfvars` holds the values that differ from the defaults in `variables.tf`, `imports.tfvars` the IDs `imports.tf` imports, and `backend.hcl` where the state is kept.

| Environment | `env` | Account | Region |
|---|---|---|---|
| dev | `dev` | 111111111111 | eu-west-2 |
| prod | `prd` | 222222222222 | eu-west-2 |

## Plan and apply an environment

Run each environment with its own credentials: the provider block sets no role of its own. For dev, and likewise for the others:

```sh
terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=vars/dev/backend.hcl
terraform plan -var-file=vars/common.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/terraform.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/imports.tfvars
terraform apply -var-file=vars/common.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/terraform.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/imports.tfvars
```

`-reconfigure` switches the working directory to the environment's state. Plan each environment before its first apply: it should import every resource and change nothing else.

## After the first apply

Once every environment has been applied, delete `imports.tf` and each `vars/<env>/imports.tfvars`, and leave `-var-file=vars/<env>/imports.tfvars` out of the commands.

## Secrets

Set `db_instance_password` for each environment from your secret store, or with `TF_VAR_<name>`, never in a var file. infraharvest never writes secret values into the configuration.
-- data.tf --
# What this configuration refers to but doesn't manage: resources the
# selection left out or other roots manage, and what the cloud or the
# provider defines.

data "aws_vpc" "vpn" {
  count = var.deploy_vpn ? 1 : 0

  id = "vpc-0abc1234"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_region" "current" {}
-- dynamodb.tf --
resource "aws_dynamodb_table" "orders" {
  name         = local.orders_name
  billing_mode = "PAY_PER_REQUEST"
  hash_key     = "id"

  dynamic "attribute" {
    for_each = var.orders_attribute

    content {
      name = attribute.value.name
      type = attribute.value.type
    }
  }
}
-- iam.tf --
resource "aws_iam_role" "ci" {
  name                 = local.ci_name
  description          = "reads arn:aws:sqs:${local.aws_region}:${local.aws_account_id}:${local.naming_prefix}-orders"
  permissions_boundary = "arn:aws:iam::${local.aws_account_id}:policy/boundary"
}
-- imports.tf --
# Each environment imports its resources on its first apply, with their IDs
# from vars/<env>/imports.tfvars. Delete this file, and those, after it.

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_vpn]

  to = aws_customer_gateway.vpn_office[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_customer_gateway.vpn_office[0]"]
}

import {
  to = aws_db_instance.main
  id = var.import_ids["aws_db_instance.main"]
}

import {
  to = aws_dynamodb_table.orders
  id = var.import_ids["aws_dynamodb_table.orders"]
}

import {
  to = aws_iam_role.ci
  id = var.import_ids["aws_iam_role.ci"]
}

import {
  to = aws_lambda_function.api
  id = var.import_ids["aws_lambda_function.api"]
}

import {
  to = aws_s3_bucket.logs
  id = var.import_ids["aws_s3_bucket.logs"]
}

import {
  to = aws_sqs_queue.orders
  id = var.import_ids["aws_sqs_queue.orders"]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_vpn]

  to = aws_vpn_connection.office[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_vpn_connection.office[0]"]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_vpn]

  to = aws_vpn_gateway.vpn[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_vpn_gateway.vpn[0]"]
}
-- lambda.tf --
resource "aws_lambda_function" "api" {
  function_name = local.api_name
  handler       = "index.handler"
  runtime       = "nodejs22.x"

  dynamic "tracing_config" {
    for_each = var.api_tracing_config == null ? [] : [var.api_tracing_config]

    content {
      mode = tracing_config.value.mode
    }
  }
}
-- locals.tf --
locals {
  naming_prefix  = "shop-${var.env}"
  aws_account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  aws_region     = data.aws_region.current.region

  # dynamodb
  orders_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-orders"

  # iam
  ci_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-ci"

  # lambda
  api_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-api"

  # rds
  db_instance_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-db"

  # s3
  logs_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-logs"

  # sqs
  sqs_queue_orders_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-orders"
}
-- providers.tf --
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7, < 2.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.14"
    }
  }

  backend "s3" {}
}

provider "aws" {
  region              = var.aws_region
  allowed_account_ids = var.allowed_account_ids

  default_tags {
    tags = {
      Environment = var.env
      Owner       = "platform"
    }
  }
}
-- rds.tf --
resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  identifier        = local.db_instance_name
  allocated_storage = 20
  engine            = "postgres"
  instance_class    = var.db_instance_instance_class
  password          = var.db_instance_password
}
-- s3.tf --
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "logs" {
  bucket        = local.logs_name
  force_destroy = var.env == "dev"
}
-- sqs.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "orders" {
  name                       = local.sqs_queue_orders_name
  delay_seconds              = 0
  visibility_timeout_seconds = var.orders_visibility_timeout_seconds
}
-- variables.tf --
variable "env" {
  description = "The token that stands for the environment in names."
  type        = string

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["dev", "prd"], var.env)
    error_message = "env must be one of dev, prd."
  }
}

variable "aws_region" {
  description = "The AWS region of the stack."
  type        = string
  default     = "eu-west-2"
}

variable "allowed_account_ids" {
  description = "The allowed_account_ids of the aws provider."
  type        = list(string)
}

variable "api_tracing_config" {
  description = "The tracing_config blocks of aws_lambda_function.api."
  type        = object({ mode = optional(string) })
  default     = null
}

variable "db_instance_instance_class" {
  description = "The instance_class of aws_db_instance.main."
  type        = string
}

variable "db_instance_password" {
  description = "The password of aws_db_instance.main."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "deploy_vpn" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_customer_gateway.vpn_office, aws_vpn_connection.office, aws_vpn_gateway.vpn."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "orders_attribute" {
  description = "The attribute blocks of aws_dynamodb_table.orders."
  type        = list(object({ name = optional(string), type = optional(string) }))
}

variable "orders_visibility_timeout_seconds" {
  description = "The visibility_timeout_seconds of aws_sqs_queue.orders."
  type        = number
}

variable "import_ids" {
  description = "The import ID of each resource the environment imports, by its address: vars/<env>/imports.tfvars sets it for imports.tf."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}
-- vars/common.tfvars --
# Values every environment shares, which the defaults in variables.tf don't
# give: none yet. Each environment's own are in vars/<env>/terraform.tfvars.
-- vars/dev/backend.hcl --
# The s3 backend's settings for the dev environment: terraform init
# -backend-config=vars/dev/backend.hcl.
bucket       = "shop-tfstate-111111111111"
key          = "envs/dev/aws/111111111111/eu-west-2/terraform.tfstate"
region       = "eu-west-2"
encrypt      = true
use_lockfile = true
-- vars/dev/imports.tfvars --
# The import ID of each resource of the dev environment, for imports.tf on
# its first apply. Delete this file with imports.tf after it.
import_ids = {
  "aws_db_instance.main"      = "shop-dev-db"
  "aws_dynamodb_table.orders" = "shop-dev-orders"
  "aws_iam_role.ci"           = "shop-dev-ci"
  "aws_lambda_function.api"   = "shop-dev-api"
  "aws_s3_bucket.logs"        = "shop-dev-logs"
  "aws_sqs_queue.orders"      = "https://sqs.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/111111111111/shop-dev-orders"
}
-- vars/dev/terraform.tfvars --
# The dev environment's values that differ from the defaults in
# variables.tf. Secrets are never set here: see README.md.
env = "dev"

# dynamodb
orders_attribute = [
  {
    name = "id"
    type = "S"
  },
]

# providers
allowed_account_ids = ["111111111111"]

# rds
db_instance_instance_class = "db.t3.micro"

# sqs
orders_visibility_timeout_seconds = 30

bucket       = "shop-tfstate-222222222222"
key          = "envs/prod/aws/222222222222/eu-west-2/terraform.tfstate"
region       = "eu-west-2"
encrypt      = true
use_lockfile = true

# The import ID of each resource of the prod environment, for imports.tf on

import_ids = {

# The prod environment's values that differ from the defaults in
# variables.tf. Secrets are never set here: see README.md.
env = "prd"

# dynamodb
orders_attribute = [
  {
    name = "id"
    type = "S"
  },
  {
    name = "sk"
    type = "S"
  },
]

# lambda
api_tracing_config = {
  mode = "Active"
}

# providers
allowed_account_ids = ["222222222222"]

# rds
db_instance_instance_class = "db.r6g.large"

# sqs
orders_visibility_timeout_seconds = 60

# vpn
deploy_vpn = true
-- vpn.tf --
resource "aws_customer_gateway" "vpn_office" {
  count = var.deploy_vpn ? 1 : 0

  bgp_asn    = 65000
  ip_address = "203.0.113.10"
  type       = "ipsec.1"
}

resource "aws_vpn_connection" "office" {
  count = var.deploy_vpn ? 1 : 0

  customer_gateway_id = aws_customer_gateway.vpn_office[0].id
  vpn_gateway_id      = aws_vpn_gateway.vpn[0].id
  type                = "ipsec.1"
}

resource "aws_vpn_gateway" "vpn" {
  count = var.deploy_vpn ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id          = data.aws_vpc.vpn[0].id
  amazon_side_asn = 64512
}
